uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: When this Pokémon has not been in combat for 5s, their movement speed is increased by 20%. Increases movement speed by 10% when out of combat. (5s after leaving combat)

Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, lunging at an opposing Pokémon and dealing increased damage to opposing Pokémon hit. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, lunging at an enemy and dealing damage.
Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, lunging at an enemy and dealing damage.

The user shoots 3 sinister flames in a cone in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit and burning them for 4s. The first flame deals full damage to each target hit; subsequent flames deal 50% of the full damage to the same target. The burn deals damage over time every 0.5s for 2s (dealing damage 3 times), and decreases Attack and Sp. Atk by 10% for 4s. Shoot multiple sinister flames, dealing damage to enemies and leaving them burned when it hits.

The user hurls a shadowy blob in the designated direction which stops at the first Pokémon from the opposing team hit, damaging opposing Pokémon hit, decreasing their movement speed by 90% for 1s, and decreasing their Sp. Def for 3s. Hurl a shadowy blob at the target, decreasing the movement speed and Sp. Defense of enemies for a short time when it hits.
Increases the damage of this move. Increased damage.

The user hurls unsanitary sludge to the designated area, poisoning opposing Pokémon in the path of the hurl or in the designated area for 5s (dealing 1% max HP Sp. Atk-based damage every 0.5s; maximum 10%), and damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect where the sludge lands. Against wild Pokémon: poison damage is capped at 120 per tick. 1% Enemy Max HP every 0.5s (as special damage) Hurl unsanitary sludge to the designated area, leaving enemies poisoned when it hits.
Strengthens poison duration to 6s (dealing maximum 12% max HP Sp. Atk-based damage). Increased poison duration.

The user extends their tongue in the designated direction, stopping at the first opposing Pokémon hit, damaging the target and pulling them toward the user's location. The user readies a boosted attack when this move is used. Attacks with the user's tongue and pulls enemies toward the user.

The user projects a hypnotic orb in the designated direction, putting the first opposing Pokémon hit to sleep for 1s and applying a Dream Eater marker on them for 5s. If a nearby opposing Pokémon has a Dream Eater marker or else is asleep when the hypnotic orb disappears, this move can be used again within 5s. This second use has the user instantly teleport behind the target, damaging the target, restoring the user's HP, and reducing the cooldown of Will-O-Wisp, Shadow Ball, or Sludge Bomb by 2s. The user readies a boosted attack each time this move is used. If the user knocks out a Pokémon from the opposing team, the cooldown of this move is reset. Puts enemies to sleep when it hits. If used again while a nearby enemy is asleep, the user appears behind the target and attacks, restoring HP and reducing the cooldown of Shadow Ball or Sludge Bomb.
Increases the damage dealt and HP restored by this move. Increased damage and HP restored.

The user becomes invincible and vanishes, then reappears at the designated location, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. If this move hits an opposing Pokémon afflicted by a status condition, the damage dealt to opposing Pokémon is doubled and the cooldown of this move is reduced by 90%. The user readies a boosted attack when this move is used. Disappear and move to the designated location, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect when the user reappears. If this hits an enemy that is afflicted by a status condition, it deals increased damage and its cooldown is reduced.
Increases the damage of this move. Increased damage.

The user becomes unstoppable as they jump forward to the designated location, then enters stealth and increases their movement speed by 30% for 7s. The user exits stealth when they use an attack. If this Unite Move is used again, the user becomes invincible as they jump out to attack, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed by 50% for 1.5s when it hits. The user readies a boosted attack each time this move is used. Jump to the designated area and start sneaking with increased movement speed. If this move is used again, it deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed for a short time.
Buffs: 80% Movement Speed, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6

If this Unite Move is used again, the user becomes invincible as they jump out to attack, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed by 50% for 1.5s when it hits. The user readies a boosted attack each time this move is used. Jump to the designated area and start sneaking with increased movement speed. If this move is used again, it deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed for a short time.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Phantom Ambush は 移動速度を下げる、妨害無効になる、無敵になる、再使用・派生・2段目を持つ。
